segments.sn22.34:1.3: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn22.34:1.5: Rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, na tumhākaṃ, taṃ pajahatha.
segments.sn22.34:1.6: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn22.34:1.7: Vedanā na tumhākaṃ … saññā na tumhākaṃ … saṅkhārā na tumhākaṃ … viññāṇaṃ na tumhākaṃ, taṃ pajahatha.
segments.sn22.34:1.11: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn22.34:1.12: Yaṃ, bhikkhave, na tumhākaṃ taṃ pajahatha.
segments.sn22.34:1.13: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissatī”ti.
